mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(ib.sku_id) || ':' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id)), 'UNASSIGNED') AS scope_key FROM inventory_balance ib LEFT JOIN risk_assessment ra ON ra.inventory_balance_id = ib.inventory_balance_id AND ra.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ib.sku_id, NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN ra.rule_version = #{ruleVersion} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY scope_key

WITH lot_balance AS ( SELECT ib.lot_id, SUM(ib.on_hand_qty + ib.reserved_qty) AS total_quantity FROM inventory_balance ib WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ib.lot_id ), resolved_lot AS ( SELECT l.lot_id, l.lot_status AS current_status, CASE WHEN l.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND l.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL THEN LEAST(TRUNC(l.expiry_date), TRUNC(l.sale_stop_date)) WHEN l.expiry_date IS NOT NULL THEN TRUNC(l.expiry_date) WHEN l.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL THEN TRUNC(l.sale_stop_date) END AS sale_end_date, CASE WHEN l.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND l.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND LEAST(TRUNC(l.expiry_date), TRUNC(l.sale_stop_date)) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) THEN CASE WHEN TRUNC(l.expiry_date) <= TRUNC(l.sale_stop_date) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'SALE_STOPPED' END WHEN l.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(l.expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN l.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(l.sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) THEN 'SALE_STOPPED' WHEN NVL(lb.total_quantity, 0) = 0 THEN 'DEPLETED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS resolved_status FROM lot l LEFT JOIN lot_balance lb ON lb.lot_id = l.lot_id WHERE l.is_deleted = 0 ), latest_forecast AS ( SELECT df.forecast_id, df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id, df.base_date, df.updated_at AS forecast_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id ORDER BY df.base_date DESC, df.updated_at DESC, df.forecast_id DESC ) AS rn FROM demand_forecast df INNER JOIN ml_model_version mv ON mv.model_version_id = df.model_version_id AND mv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE df.is_deleted = 0 AND df.base_date >= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) - 1 AND df.base_date < TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) + 1 AND df.forecast_source <> 'DUMMY_BASELINE' ), risk_rows AS ( SELECT ib.sku_id, NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) AS sales_point_id, ra.forecast_id, TRUNC(COALESCE(isr.started_at, ra.updated_at)) AS assessed_date, COALESCE(isr.started_at, ra.updated_at) AS assessed_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ib.sku_id, NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) ORDER BY ra.updated_at DESC, ra.risk_assessment_id DESC ) AS rn FROM risk_assessment ra INNER JOIN inventory_balance ib ON ib.inventory_balance_id = ra.inventory_balance_id AND ib.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN inventory_sync_run isr ON isr.inventory_sync_run_id = ra.inventory_sync_run_id WHERE ra.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(ib.sku_id) || ':' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id)), 'UNASSIGNED') AS scope_key FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN resolved_lot rl ON rl.lot_id = ib.lot_id LEFT JOIN latest_forecast lf ON lf.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND lf.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) AND lf.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN risk_rows rr ON rr.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND (rr.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) OR (rr.sales_point_id IS NULL AND NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) IS NULL)) AND rr.rn = 1 WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND ( NVL(rl.current_status, '__NULL__') != rl.resolved_status OR ( rl.sale_end_date IS NOT NULL AND rl.sale_end_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) AND rl.sale_end_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) + 90 AND (rr.assessed_date IS NULL OR rr.assessed_date < TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) ) OR NVL(rr.forecast_id, -1) != NVL(lf.forecast_id, -1) OR (lf.forecast_updated_at IS NOT NULL AND (rr.assessed_at IS NULL OR lf.forecast_updated_at > rr.assessed_at)) ) ORDER BY scope_key

WITH candidate_scopes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ib.sku_id, NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) AS sales_point_id FROM inventory_balance ib WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND (TO_CHAR(ib.sku_id) || ':' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id)), 'UNASSIGNED')) IN #{scopeKey} ), latest_forecast AS ( SELECT df.forecast_id, df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id, df.base_date, df.predicted_qty_d7, df.predicted_qty_d14, df.predicted_qty_d30, df.predicted_qty_d60, df.predicted_qty_d90, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id ORDER BY df.base_date DESC, df.updated_at DESC, df.forecast_id DESC ) AS rn FROM demand_forecast df INNER JOIN candidate_scopes cs ON cs.sku_id = df.sku_id AND (cs.sales_point_id = df.sales_point_id OR (cs.sales_point_id IS NULL AND df.sales_point_id IS NULL)) INNER JOIN ml_model_version mv ON mv.model_version_id = df.model_version_id AND mv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE df.is_deleted = 0 AND df.base_date >= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) - 1 AND df.base_date < TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) + 1 AND df.updated_at <= #{assessmentInstant} AND df.forecast_source <> 'DUMMY_BASELINE' ), latest_policy AS ( SELECT ip.sku_id, NVL(ip.stock_sales_point_id, ip.allocated_sales_point_id) AS sales_point_id, ip.safety_stock_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ip.sku_id, NVL(ip.stock_sales_point_id, ip.allocated_sales_point_id) ORDER BY ip.effective_from DESC NULLS LAST, ip.inventory_policy_id DESC) AS rn FROM inventory_policy ip INNER JOIN candidate_scopes cs ON cs.sku_id = ip.sku_id AND (cs.sales_point_id = NVL(ip.stock_sales_point_id, ip.allocated_sales_point_id) OR (cs.sales_point_id IS NULL AND NVL(ip.stock_sales_point_id, ip.allocated_sales_point_id) IS NULL)) WHERE ip.is_deleted = 0 AND (ip.effective_from IS NULL OR ip.effective_from <= #{asOfDate}) AND (ip.effective_to IS NULL OR ip.effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ) SELECT ib.inventory_balance_id, ib.sku_id, NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) AS sales_point_id, lf.forecast_id, s.sku_code, COALESCE(sp.sales_point_code, 'UNASSIGNED') AS sales_point_code, ib.on_hand_qty, lf.predicted_qty_d7, lf.predicted_qty_d14, lf.predicted_qty_d30, lf.predicted_qty_d60, lf.predicted_qty_d90, lp.safety_stock_qty, lf.base_date AS forecast_base_date, TO_CHAR(l.lot_id) AS lot_id, l.lot_no AS lot_number, l.expiry_date, l.sale_stop_date, l.received_date, l.lot_status, ib.on_hand_qty AS lot_qty, ib.reserved_qty AS lot_reserved_qty FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN candidate_scopes cs ON cs.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND (cs.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) OR (cs.sales_point_id IS NULL AND NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) IS NULL)) JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) AND sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN latest_forecast lf ON lf.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND (lf.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) OR (lf.sales_point_id IS NULL AND NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) IS NULL)) AND lf.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN latest_policy lp ON lp.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND (lp.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) OR (lp.sales_point_id IS NULL AND NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) IS NULL)) AND lp.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ib.lot_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0
